text: Church Boutique Hotel Nha Tho | Boutique Hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter Church Boutique Hotel Nha Tho A charming boutique hotel in the heart of Hanoi Old Quarter Check Availability on Agoda Stay in the Heart of Hanoi Located on historic Nha Tho Street in the vibrant Old Quarter, Church Boutique Hotel Nha Tho offers travelers a perfect blend of Vietnamese charm and modern comfort. Just steps from St Joseph Cathedral and a short walk to Hoan Kiem Lake, the hotel places guests right in the cultural center of Hanoi. The hotel features stylish rooms, attentive service, and convenient access to Hanoi's most famous attractions, restaurants, and shopping streets. Hotel Highlights Prime Old Quarter Location Stay just minutes from Hoan Kiem Lake, Ngoc Son Temple, and the iconic Hanoi Cathedral. Boutique Style Rooms Elegant rooms featuring air conditioning, flat-screen TV, minibar, and modern bathrooms. 24-Hour Service Friendly reception, concierge assistance, and tour booking available anytime. Restaurant & Dining Enjoy Vietnamese cuisine and international dishes served at the hotel restaurant. Comfortable Rooms & Amenities Each room at Church Boutique Hotel Nha Tho is designed with comfort in mind. Guests can enjoy air-conditioned rooms with complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen televisions, minibars, and tea or coffee facilities. Private bathrooms include bathrobes, slippers, and quality toiletries for a relaxing stay. :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2} Additional hotel services include room service, concierge support, tour assistance, and transportation arrangements to help guests explore Hanoi easily. :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index=3} Explore Hanoi's Top Attractions The hotel's central location makes it easy to visit many of Hanoi's famous landmarks: Hoan Kiem Lake – 5 minute walk St Joseph Cathedral – steps away Ngoc Son Temple – nearby historic site Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre Dong Xuan Market Many of these attractions are reachable within a short walk from the hotel in the Old Quarter. :contentReference[oaicite:4]{index=4} Photo Gallery Book Your Stay in Hanoi Today Experience boutique hospitality in the heart of Hanoi Old Quarter.
